description: THD degree programme and cohort-start taxonomy containing records with substantiated programme codes. This is a discovery aid, not proof of enrolment.

codePolicy.verified: The short code is taken from the official THD programme-page URL and that page is included in the record's sources.
codePolicy.provisional: No programme-specific official code was substantiated in this pass; do not use the candidate code as an official cohort identifier.

notes: The displayed semester is the cohort's current curriculum semester for the current academic term; it is not a promise that a student has passed every previous semester.
Keep AIN (English) and KI (German) as separate programmes.
Some programmes have different start terms by language variant or campus, so use each record's intakeTerms rather than assuming every programme starts in both terms.
Extension semesters 8 and 9 are allowed cohort labels, not separate programmes or intake terms.
Where the same short code has multiple campuses or study modes, include campus and study mode in the stable cohort key to avoid collisions.

Do not create or match a batch using a record whose codeStatus is provisional. Verify those candidate codes against the current programme-specific handbook before treating them as official cohort identifiers.

edgeCases.title: AIN and KI are separate programmes
edgeCases.details: AIN is the English-taught Artificial Intelligence B.Sc.; KI is the German-taught Künstliche Intelligenz B.Sc. Do not merge their cohorts just because their subject names translate to one another.

edgeCases.title: Some programmes accept different intakes by variant or location
edgeCases.details: Examples include Business Administration and Service Management (summer), international engineering variants (summer), Nursing (international pathway, summer), and Mechatronic and Cyber-Physical Systems (Deggendorf winter versus Cham summer). Verify each record rather than applying a single university-wide term.

edgeCases.title: Traffic Sciences intake status needs a current notice
edgeCases.details: The application overview says Traffic Sciences was not offered in WS 2025/26, while the current bachelor catalogue still lists the programme. As the negative notice refers to a past intake, the dataset marks future intake unverified rather than assuming the programme is still discontinued.

edgeCases.title: Automotive Electronics catalogue mismatch
edgeCases.details: Automotive Electronics appears in the application overview but not in the current master catalogue. It is retained for reconciliation and marked catalogue_conflict rather than presented as definitively active.

edgeCases.title: Engineering programme English-name mismatch
edgeCases.details: The current German bachelor catalogue says Engineering Nachhaltiger Systeme, while the application matrix uses Interdisciplinary Engineering Sciences. This row is flagged for confirmation before aliases are treated as equivalent.

edgeCases.title: Master's programmes and extension semesters
edgeCases.details: Master's programmes are separate degree-level identities with their own standard durations and start terms. Do not infer that semesters 8 and 9 are part of every master's curriculum; the extension labels are a cohort-display allowance.

edgeCases.title: Programme codes need differing confidence levels
edgeCases.details: Codes verified against individual THD programme-page URLs are marked verified and cite those pages. Remaining provisional codes need programme-specific evidence before they can be used as official cohort identifiers.

edgeCases.title: Part-time durations are not in the overview table
edgeCases.details: Part-time programmes are listed because they are degree programmes, but durationSemesters is null where the official overview table did not state a duration. Resolve these from programme-specific pages or module handbooks rather than copying full-time duration assumptions.

edgeCases.title: Discontinued and legacy programmes
edgeCases.details: Interactive Systems / Internet of Things and Sustainability in Polymer Technology are retained with status discontinued for historical cohorts only. THD explicitly states that Interactive Systems / Internet of Things is discontinued and that Sustainability in Polymer Technology is no longer offered. Construction Management and Applied Physics are marked catalogue_conflict because handbook entries exist but current catalogues do not show them.

edgeCases.title: Current catalogue and module-handbook index may disagree
edgeCases.details: Bioinformatics is present in the handbook index for WS 2025/26 and in faculty listings, but absent from the current bachelor catalogue. Keep it flagged until THD confirms whether new cohorts are still admitted.

edgeCases.title: Only programmes with substantiated codes are included
edgeCases.details: This catalogue intentionally excludes records whose programme code could not be substantiated against an official programme page or handbook reference. Add those programmes only after confirming their official short code and faculty from THD sources.
